title: Fix Menu Bar AI Allowance Meter Display and Resolve Ambiguous Multi-Tenant Governance on /api/ai-usage
spec:
# SECTION 1 — EXECUTIVE MANDATE
Restore the authoritative AI Allowance menubar readout (✦ Usage: X/Y via AiTokenMeter.jsx) on the universal header (CubaAppShell.jsx) and suppress the unintended ● ✦ AI Engine Ready beacon.

USER OBJECTIVE:
The user reported that their available AI requests are missing from the menu bar, providing a screenshot showing ● ✦ AI Engine Ready instead of ✦ Usage: X/Y. Review and fix the issues causing this regression so that users see their actual available requests on the menu bar.

ROOT CAUSE:
1. CSS display conflict: In src/components/cuba/AiEngineStatus.jsx, 'inline-flex' is hardcoded in the root <span> base class list. In src/components/cuba/CubaAppShell.jsx:545, <AiEngineStatus status={aiStatus} className="hidden" /> attempts to hide it. In the compiled CSS, .inline-flex takes precedence over .hidden, so the beacon remains visible instead of hidden.
2. Multi-tenant quota resolution 400 failure: For signed-in users with multiple active enterprise tenant memberships (such as Super Admin bhaskar.beyond@gmail.com), backend/security/aiGovernance.js flags loadApplicableTenantMembership with AMBIGUOUS_ACTIVE_TENANT. On the universal menu bar, useAiTokenUsage.js queries GET /api/ai-usage without an X-Tenant-Id header. The governance resolver fails closed with HTTP 400 TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED. Consequently, useAiTokenUsage sets status to UNAVAILABLE, and AiTokenMeter.jsx fails closed (returns null), completely hiding the allowance chip from the menu bar.

SCOPE:
1. Fix src/components/cuba/AiEngineStatus.jsx: Remove the hardcoded inline-flex from base classes so className="hidden" cleanly suppresses the beacon.
2. Fix backend/security/aiGovernance.js (and/or backend/routes/ai.js): When resolving AI quota for general telemetry/readout at /api/ai-usage (or when no X-Tenant-Id is sent by the global shell for multi-tenant users), do not hard-fail with 400. Instead, gracefully resolve to the user's primary/active tenant membership (e.g. latest active membership sorted by updated_at) or individual fallback with appropriate quotaScope, allowing the user's daily usage and limit to be returned truthfully.
3. Verify src/components/cuba/AiTokenMeter.jsx: Confirm the chip renders cleanly with Usage: <used>/<limit>, appropriate tooltip, accessible label, and correct tone.
4. Run automated tests (tests/ai-token-meter.test.mjs, backend/test/ai-governance-entitlement.test.js).
5. Rebuild production bundle (npm run build) so Apache serves the updated assets from dist/.
6. Perform live Playwright verification confirming AiTokenMeter is visible and AiEngineStatus is suppressed.

# SECTION 2 — ABSOLUTE MODE RESTRICTIONS: PLAN MODE VS ACT MODE
PLAN MODE: Read-only inspection of AiEngineStatus.jsx, CubaAppShell.jsx, aiGovernance.js, routes/ai.js, useAiTokenUsage.js, and test suites. Submit plan via bridge dev plan.
ACT MODE: Authorized surgical implementation of CSS display fix, backend multi-tenant usage resolution, test updates, and production build.

# SECTION 3 — PRE-FLIGHT REPOSITORY AND WORKSPACE VERIFICATION
Workspace: D:\xampp\htdocs\IME365. Baseline: src/cv-templates/ and backend/services/aiRuntime.js must remain 0-byte diff. Node runtime on Windows with XAMPP Apache + MariaDB.

# SECTION 4 — NON-NEGOTIABLE PROJECT INVARIANTS
1. Zero fake telemetry: Never invent an allowance, limit, or percentage the server did not measure (§46).
2. Fail closed on execution: While telemetry readouts should fall back gracefully to primary tenant or personal allowance, actual generative AI execution (/api/ai/*) preserves strict tenant boundaries.
3. Cuba Executive Glassmorphism tokens: Use var(--cuba-*) tokens, WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios (>= 4.5:1), and no raw hex colors.
4. Single surface for AI allowance: Preserve the invariant that the menubar chip is the single home for the user's daily AI allowance.

# SECTION 5 — AUTHORITATIVE REFERENCES AND PARITY REQUIREMENTS
User screenshot showing ● ✦ AI Engine Ready between Help (?) and Notification (🔔) icon, src/components/cuba/CubaAppShell.jsx, src/components/cuba/AiEngineStatus.jsx, src/components/cuba/AiTokenMeter.jsx, src/hooks/useAiTokenUsage.js, backend/security/aiGovernance.js, backend/routes/ai.js.

# SECTION 6 — MANDATORY INVESTIGATION AND COVERAGE
Investigate:
- src/components/cuba/AiEngineStatus.jsx lines 21-46.
- src/components/cuba/CubaAppShell.jsx lines 545-558.
- src/components/cuba/AiTokenMeter.jsx lines 36-96.
- src/hooks/useAiTokenUsage.js lines 48-100.
- backend/security/aiGovernance.js lines 68-155.
- backend/routes/ai.js lines 48-119.
- tests/ai-token-meter.test.mjs.

# SECTION 7 — QUALITY, RESPONSIVENESS, ACCESSIBILITY, AND NON-FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS
WCAG 2.1 AA compliant, responsive at 320px, 768px, and 1440px (hidden below sm, visible sm and above). Tooltip and sr-only description intact.

# SECTION 8 — DATA INTEGRITY, STATE MANAGEMENT, AND EDGE CASES
Handle users with 0 tenant memberships (individual plan), 1 tenant membership (org plan), and multiple tenant memberships (primary org or individual resolution without 400 rejection).

# SECTION 9 — TEST STRATEGY AND ACCEPTANCE REQUIREMENTS
1. node --test tests/ai-token-meter.test.mjs must pass 100%.
2. node --test backend/test/ai-governance-entitlement.test.js must pass 100%.
3. Production build npm run build must exit 0 under 4.0s budget.
4. Playwright verification proving:
   - AiEngineStatus beacon is suppressed (hidden).
   - AiTokenMeter ([data-testid="ai-token-meter"]) is visible and displays Usage: <used>/<limit> for authenticated users.

# SECTION 10 — REQUIRED FORENSIC AND ENGINEERING DELIVERABLES
1. Surgical update to src/components/cuba/AiEngineStatus.jsx.
2. Surgical update to backend/security/aiGovernance.js and/or backend/routes/ai.js.
3. Passing test suite and build output.
4. Playwright crawl evidence log submitted via bridge dev submit-evidence.

# SECTION 11 — SEVERITY, PRIORITISATION, AND IMPLEMENTATION SEQUENCING
P0: Fix CSS suppression in AiEngineStatus.jsx and multi-tenant resolution in aiGovernance.js / routes/ai.js.
P1: Test updates and production build.
P2: Playwright crawl and evidence submission.

# SECTION 12 — REQUIRED FINAL RESPONSE AND COMPLETION REPORT
Report exact test commands + exit codes, Playwright crawl proof, git diff, and 0-byte verification on protected files.

# SECTION 13 — MANDATORY BRIDGE PLAN SUBMISSION AND TOOL EXECUTION GOVERNANCE
Submit plan via:
bridge dev plan --directive DIR-106 --summary "..." --steps "S1;S2..."
Submit heartbeats <= 480s.
Submit evidence via:
bridge dev submit-evidence --directive DIR-106 --summary "..." --tests "..."

# SECTION 14 — FINAL EXECUTIVE INSTRUCTION
Root-cause over symptom patching; do not break single-tenant isolation; ensure the menubar correctly displays the user's available requests.

plan.summary: DIR-106 PLAN v3, all five prior critiques addressed. SYSTEMS ARCHITECT: contract boundaries pinned and invariants affirmed. PRODUCT/UX: explicit chip states and glassmorphism polish. RESPONSIVE: validation at 320, 768 and 1440 px. ACCESSIBILITY WCAG 2.2: keyboard and focus posture plus axe-core. PERFORMANCE: render budget under 100ms and a Promise.all waterfall reduction.
steps: S1 Pin the contract surface: keep aiGovernance.js exports unchanged, add only an optional options argument to resolveAiGovernance, keep every /api/ai-usage payload key and add only ambiguousTenant, freeze the ai-token-meter and ai-engine-status DOM testids, preserve the aiPaths gate and the isTenantAwareRoute /ai-usage pin, and reaffirm INV-1 0-byte frozen files, INV-3 no client quota maths, no fabricated telemetry and fail-closed execution

S2 CSS FIX: remove inline-flex from the AiEngineStatus base class list so display is caller-owned while the shell already passes className hidden, keeping the tone, tooltip, sr-only meaning, testid and data-ai-status unchanged

S3 BACKEND: add an opt-in allowAmbiguousSelection option so the strict default still returns AMBIGUOUS_ACTIVE_TENANT with 400 TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED while the telemetry path deterministically selects the primary membership ordered by updated_at then tenantId and returns ORGANIZATION with ambiguous true

S4 ROUTE: in the /ai-usage handler opt into graceful selection and recompute remainingToday and isExhausted from the same effectiveLimit the gate enforces, keeping quotaScope, tenantId, orgDailyLimit, the 503 fail-closed path and the rule that uid is read only from the verified token
S5 WATERFALL: run resolveAiGovernance and getUserAiEntitlement concurrently with Promise.all to remove one serial MariaDB hop, checking governance errors first and mapping entitlement errors to 503

S6 UX STATES: enumerate and verify loading, unavailable, healthy, low, exhausted and organization states, confirming cuba-line and cuba-card glassmorphism tokens and the clean Help then meter then bell then avatar trail
S7 RESPONSIVE: validate at 320, 768 and 1440 px with the chip hidden below sm and the beacon hidden at every width, no horizontal overflow and no duplicate allowance in the account menu

S8 ACCESSIBILITY: confirm WCAG 2.2 posture, the chip stays a non-interactive non-tabstop span, the full meaning stays in the cuba-sr-only sentence, no dangling aria-describedby remains and axe-core reports zero critical or serious violations
S9 PERFORMANCE: measure the single-span chip contribution with performance.now and a requestAnimationFrame delta under the 100ms budget and record TTFB and paint deltas

S10 TESTS: extend backend/test/ai-governance-entitlement.test.js with a graceful-mode two-tenant case and tests/ai-token-meter.test.mjs with a source assertion that the handler opts into allowAmbiguousSelection, then run both suites plus ai-abuse to 100 percent
S11 BUILD: run npm run build under the 4.0s budget so Apache serves the updated dist and verify 0-byte diff on src/cv-templates and backend/services/aiRuntime.js

S12 E2E: extend the DIR-105 authenticated Playwright pattern into a DIR-106 spec proving the beacon is suppressed and the chip shows Usage X over Y against a real Firebase session and unstubbed /api/ai-usage, save logs to .bridge/evidence/dir106 and submit evidence

evidence.summary: DIR-106 fixed and verified live. RC-3 made the used/limit/remaining triple internally consistent. RC-4 runs governance and entitlement reads concurrently.
